reviews.text: Wonderful. Incredible service. Professional. Good prices.

I wanted to thank Miguel and Marcos for everything they did for my budgie, Kiri. Despite how critical his condition was when he arrived Monday morning, and it seemed almost impossible for him to recover, they never lost hope, and they gave me hope too. They gave my little one five more days of life, during which he was at least very well cared for and looked after. I would have loved for the ending to have been different and for Kiri to have been able to come home, but we knew from the beginning that he was very fragile. I had the opportunity to visit him several times and say goodbye to him yesterday, not knowing it would be the last day. But at least the last time I saw him, he had that energy and that look he had at home. All thanks to them. So, thank you from the bottom of my heart for all the effort and love you gave my little one these past few days. I will always be so grateful. ❤️‍🩹

A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for taking such good care of Arya during such a difficult few weeks. She arrived at the emergency room with severe pancreatitis, among other things, after having been in a dog hotel. She spent time in the ICU in critical condition, and we didn't know if she would make it. Being able to still have her with us today means so much.

I want to especially thank Stella, who treated us in the emergency room and who is our angel. She will always have a very special place in our family for taking care of Arya during such a delicate time.

Thank you also to Laura, who continues to manage her treatment and support us in her recovery, and to everyone who cared for her during her hospitalization.

We will never forget what you have done for Arya and for us. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Thank you again to the entire team for fighting so that my little Arya pulled through. Ary continues to enjoy life thanks to you.

Thank you so much for your five-star rating, Eva. It motivates us to continue providing quality service to our patients and their families.
Madrid Centro Veterinary Hospital Team
Very professional and friendly staff, and good service.
This hospital is wonderful; the facilities are incredible and perfectly equipped for feline medicine. The team is super professional, especially Rubén, who treated us with great care.

Your feedback is really important to us, Elena. We want to thank you for taking the time to leave us a five-star review. We're still here to provide the best possible care for every patient.
Madrid Central Veterinary Hospital Team

We are delighted with Laura. She treated my 10-year-old dog, Roco, with so much love, patience, and empathy from the very first moment. Roco was quite ill with cystitis, and thanks to her care and follow-up, he is now doing very well and has returned to his normal life.

It's clear that Laura is not only a great professional, but also genuinely cares about animals and how their families feel. She always put us at ease, explained everything clearly, and treated Roco with incredible affection.

We are so glad we found her. Without a doubt, a fantastic veterinarian.

It's a pleasure to receive your recognition, Consolacion. You can always count on our team for the well-being of your animals.
Madrid Central Veterinary Hospital Team
I didn't meet them, but I think their service is very good.

We greatly appreciate your positive review. We are here to provide the best possible care to all our patients and their families. We hope to see you again soon.
Madrid Central Veterinary Hospital Team

Thank you for your feedback, Christina, and we remain committed to the health and well-being of every patient.
Madrid Central Veterinary Hospital Team

I took my cat, Cali, to the hospital because he was sick with vomiting and barely eating. The veterinary team provided excellent care; they treated him very well, and he was very calm because he was seen in a room exclusively for cats. They ran tests to make sure everything was alright and prescribed treatment, and within a few days, he was completely recovered. When I got home, I had some questions, so I called, and they answered all my queries about his care at home. Highly recommended for all families with cats.
I am very grateful to the entire team for the care our dog received. I want to highlight both the professionalism and the warmth of all the staff during such a difficult time.

I've taken my dog ​​Bimba to the Madrid Centro Veterinary Hospital twice. The first time was for an emergency visit; my dog ​​was quite ill and had to be hospitalized. The second time was to check on a heart problem. On both occasions, the care my dog ​​received was outstanding. The staff was very friendly and provided me with all the necessary information. I will definitely return to this hospital.

I took my dog ​​there twice, the first time for a dermatological problem, and the second time to the emergency room, where the treatment was outstanding. THANK YOU for taking such good care of my furry friend.
They saved Ron, we are very grateful. Everyone was very kind and the service was excellent.

The veterinary team is fantastic; they've treated several of our dogs' emergencies with the utmost professionalism and care. The reception staff are always kind to our animals and, above all, they help us schedule the best possible appointment when we need to return to the hospital, adapting to our needs. The facilities are huge and spotlessly clean!

I went to the clinic one afternoon to ask about my cats' food, and what struck me most was the tranquility of the place. The cats have their own private room, which makes them very calm and allows for much better treatment.
I was absolutely delighted with the food; they were very helpful and answered several questions I had. I will return whenever I need to, and I recommend it to everyone so their pet is in good hands.

Thank you so much for everything.

We recently took our kitten there, and the service was excellent. We were in a waiting room just for kittens, which I thought was wonderful and very helpful because my cat gets very stressed. He was seen by a veterinarian who specializes in cats, which I loved. The facilities were very clean, and the rest of the staff was very friendly at all times. They explained everything to us as they treated him, and very gently because he's older. Highly recommended. Thank you.

My dog ​​was admitted and couldn't have received better care from the entire team! They were also incredibly attentive to the family, and the day after he was discharged, they sent us a very detailed report.
Disastrous

My cat (Wasabi) was hospitalized for several days in very critical condition. I don't question the diagnosis or the severity of his illness, and I appreciate the care he received during his stay.

What I do believe is that the way the prognosis is communicated should be improved. I specifically asked if he might only have a week left, and they answered very bluntly: "No, days." I understand that his condition at the time might have seemed that way, but in cats, the hospital environment, stress, and lack of appetite can have a significant impact.

When we returned home, he started eating, urinating, resting better, interacting, and even playing. Two weeks later, he continues to have moments of good quality of life.

I know that this doesn't change his illness, but it does demonstrate how difficult it is to give such specific timeframes. That response caused me immense anguish for several days, thinking his death was imminent. I think it would have been more appropriate to explain that it could be just a few days, but making it clear that there was uncertainty and that his progress would need to be assessed at home.

I had a very good impression of this veterinary hospital. The facilities were very clean, tidy, and perfectly maintained, inspiring confidence from the first moment. They also offer a wide range of services, which is very reassuring knowing they can address various needs of our pets all in one place.

I especially want to highlight the attention from the veterinary team, who were very friendly, professional, and kind. They took the time to listen, answer questions, and provide care with great affection and dedication. It's clear they care deeply about the well-being of the animals and the peace of mind of their owners—undoubtedly a top-notch hospital in every sense.

Rollo had surgery for a hernia, and everything went wonderfully. He was in a lot of pain, so we took him to the emergency room. After an MRI, they confirmed he had a hernia that needed urgent surgery. The surgery was performed two days later and was a success. Rollo recovered very quickly, and the entire team was fantastic, especially the neurologist, Rebeca. With all the visits we made, almost the entire hospital staff saw my dog, and we are incredibly grateful for all the care and urgency they showed. Now we're taking him to rehabilitation with Carlota, and the improvement with the underwater treadmill is amazing. It's really helping him, along with the acupuncture! He's doing even better than we are now :) Thank you, team!!

We arrived at 5 a.m. My dog ​​collapsed; he was having trouble breathing. They took an x-ray and told me all his organs were fine. They gave him metamisole and discharged him, but he was still very ill at home. He had these episodes a couple of times. We went back and they did blood work. They told me he was very serious and needed to be hospitalized. It cost 200 euros a day, which I couldn't afford. I asked for treatment to take home, but they said they couldn't do anything; the only option was to admit him. I took him home. On Monday, his vet saw him and prescribed medication to clear the fluid from his lungs. Thanks to him, my dog ​​is doing quite well.

We had been to this clinic before and had a good experience, so we decided to return when our cat started losing weight.
After examining him, the veterinarian recommended some tests. I specifically asked how much they would cost before agreeing to them, precisely to make sure we could afford them. We were also told the results would take about 25 minutes, but we waited for over an hour without any news.
Then, without explaining what she was going to do or asking for our consent, she administered two medications that weren't strictly necessary. One caused him to defecate immediately, which made it very difficult for us to get home in an Uber. She also applied an appetite stimulant to his ear that we hadn't requested and for which they charged us €30, even though it's available elsewhere for €8.
In the end, the bill was more than €50 higher than the amount we had been quoted. We felt cheated by the lack of information, consent, and transparency. If we ask the price before agreeing to the tests, it's precisely because we need to know how much we're going to pay and decide on any additional expenses. We won't be back.

Everything is fine with my dog, the surgery went very well, but the wait time is terrible. I brought her in for a follow-up appointment and then she sat here for over two hours waiting. It's not the first time this has happened, I wish they would improve their service.

First of all, thank you so much! I went last week with my 12-year-old dog who wasn't eating and was very lethargic. From the moment I walked in, I was delighted by the friendliness of the reception staff and how quickly we were shown to the waiting room. Once in the examination room, the veterinarian who saw us was very kind and explained all the steps involved in trying to reach a diagnosis. It turned out she had pancreatitis, we had to admit her, and after a few days, she's pulled through. We are incredibly grateful and thrilled with the care my dog ​​and we received. They were always very empathetic and professional, doing everything they could to help my dog ​​recover as if she were their own. I am truly eternally grateful to the entire team who treated my dog.

When my dog ​​developed a huge lump and our vet was on vacation, we took him to this hospital. From the very beginning, starting with the reception staff, they treated us with so much kindness. We want to thank Lucía for her patience with us and for the special care she gave our big boy. She was attentive and checked on him even after the appointments, both by phone and email. Thank you so much!
